notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 566f6154 - hipercontracer: don't consume kerberos messages
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18963/diffs?diff_id=1256799396&start_sha=7db030e2f67dbc2f77c85f9964991ea5a2971e13)

The HiPerContracer dissector, after !18886, is now passing the heuristic for ~14.37% of all TCP and UDP packets, up from less than 0.01437% of the packet space before the commit. (One thousand times more packets are accepted.)

I don't think that individually trying to exempt certain protocols is the correct approach now (it made more sense perhaps when the heuristics were more discerning.) I think that the HiPerConTracer heuristics need to be strengthened in general, or else disabled (at least over TCP and UDP) by default.
Though the changes in the Kerberos dissector seem useful.
I'm not sure if this is necessary after !19011
We can close this, I may later create a new MR for the kerberos helper...
